{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Upon your steed Aarwynn, first humbaba<br />Of the sacred line born beneath the Tree-Queen's fingers.|An excerpt from ''[[The Twilight Chant]]'', part of Kashoonara folklore|<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>}}
The '''Tree-Queen''' was a figure in [[Kashoonara]] folklore. [[Aarwynn]], a giant [[humbaba]], was said to have been born beneath the Tree-Queen's fingers.
